crossRefs.note: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.
Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get…
Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel…

translations.web: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
translations.bsb: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
translations.kjv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy
translations.asv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
